mayNotHaveFinished: The sign-out may not have finished. Check whether you are still signed in.
background: A sign-out from a federation partner is checked exactly as a sign-in from it is: it must come from the partner the relationship names, carry a valid signature where the relationship requires one, and be used within its validity, once. A refused sign-out is recorded on the relationship as fedLastError, and in the audit log.
refusal.general: The partner's sign-out could not be accepted.
refusal.STS-FED-0001: Federation is switched off on this service, so there is no single logout service at this address.
refusal.STS-FED-0002: No federation relationship that signs people in here has the name in this address, so there is no single logout service at it.
refusal.STS-FED-0005: The federation relationship this sign-out is for is disabled, so the sign-out was refused without being read.
refusal.STS-FED-0006: The federation relationship this sign-out is for is not fully configured, so the sign-out cannot be checked.
refusal.STS-FED-0114: The partner's sign-out message could not be read: it is not a well-formed SAML LogoutRequest or LogoutResponse, or it names nobody.
refusal.STS-FED-0115: The partner's sign-out message is not signed, and this relationship accepts only a signed one.
refusal.STS-FED-0116: The signature on the partner's sign-out message could not be verified against the partner's certificate.
refusal.STS-FED-0117: The sign-out message was issued by somebody other than this relationship's partner.
refusal.STS-FED-0118: The sign-out message is addressed to another endpoint: its Destination is not this single logout service.
refusal.STS-FED-0119: The sign-out message is not valid now: it has expired, or it was issued too long ago or in the future.
refusal.STS-FED-0120: This sign-out message has already been used once, so it was refused as a replay.
refusal.STS-FED-0121: This service could not check whether the sign-out message had been used before, so it refused it. Try again later.
refusal.STS-FED-0123: This relationship does not accept sign-outs from its partner.
refusal.STS-FED-0124: This sign-out answer does not answer any LogoutRequest this service sent, or that request has already been answered or has expired.
refusal.STS-FED-0126: The sign-out confirmation could not be accepted: it was not drawn for this browser, or it has already been used or has expired.
refusal.STS-FED-0130: The partner's front-channel sign-out request does not name the partner (iss) and its session (sid) as it must.
refusal.STS-FED-0134: You came back from the partner's sign-out with a state this service did not send, or one that has already been used or has expired.
refusal.STS-FED-0135: This single logout service received something that its relationship's protocol does not define as a sign-out.
refusal.STS-FED-0136: Something went wrong on this service while it was handling the partner's sign-out.
refusal.STS-FED-0137: Part of the sign-out message is encrypted, and this relationship holds no key that can decrypt it.
refusal.STS-FED-0138: An encrypted part of the sign-out message (its EncryptedID) could not be decrypted, or did not hold a NameID.
refusal.STS-FED-0139: Part of the sign-out message is encrypted with an algorithm this relationship does not accept.
refusal.STS-AUTHN-0338: This service could not read the sign-on sessions just now, so it could not tell what to sign out. Try again in a moment.
